+def _adjust_palette_lightness(im, factor):
+    """
+    Scale the brightness of the palette of the "P" image ``im`` in place.
+
+    Only the palette changes, in the image core and in the Python palette
+    object alike, so every pixel keeps its index and no color is added. Each
+    red, green and blue value is multiplied by ``factor``, truncated to a whole
+    number and limited to 255; an alpha channel is left as it is.
+    """
+    table = bytes(
+        0 if value == 0 else int(min(255.0, value * factor)) for value in range(256)
+    )
+
+    # The core palette also answers convert() and the pixel access.
+    mode = im.im.getpalettemode()
+    alphas = im.im.getpalette("RGBA", "RGBA")[3::4] if mode == "RGBA" else None
+    im.im.putpalette("RGB", im.im.getpalette("RGB", "RGB").translate(table))
+    if alphas is not None:
+        im.im.putpalettealphas(alphas)
+
+    # The Python palette is what save() writes out.
+    channels = len(im.palette.mode)
+    data = bytearray(im.palette.palette)
+    for channel in range(min(3, channels)):
+        data[channel::channels] = data[channel::channels].translate(table)
+    im.palette.palette = bytes(data)
+
